title: Efficient and Effective Implicit Dynamic Graph Neural Network

problem.claim: Dynamic graphs intensify the tension between oversmoothing-related performance degradation and modeling long-range dependencies because features are aggregated across neighborhoods and time.

gap.claim: No prior work has proposed an implicit graph neural model for a dynamic setting.

narrative_sequence.summary: Implicit graph neural networks capture long-range dependencies and improve predictive performance in static graphs.
Dynamic graphs create a stronger oversmoothing and long-range-dependency challenge, and the abstract identifies an absence of prior implicit graph neural models for dynamic settings.

unknowns: The abstract units do not state the proposed method or its mechanism.
